description: Close work - bleeds, dirty blades, and a counterpunch for anything that misses you.
_source_note: Rebuilt 6 Nov 2026 from the 39 real CoA Brigand talents (role DPS, melee). Eleven CoA talents are conditional on weapon type and nothing reads weapon type, so those conditions are all dropped. Advantage stacks are unreadable. Quick-Witted ports verbatim off on_avoid, which only became worth building after creature avoidance landed on 5 Nov 2026. Archery owns the class execute threshold.

nodes.name: Banditry
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 4% and reduces all your ability costs by 10%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases your critical strike chance by 2% and Focus regeneration by 15%.' The crit ports (doubled). FOCUS REGENERATION HAS NO KEY: energy_regen, energy_regen_pct and resource_regen_pct are all dead data, authored by several talents and read by nothing. Repriced as a cost reduction, which reaches the same place - more shots per pool - through a key that works. all_ability_cost_pct is a FRACTION where POSITIVE MEANS A REDUCTION. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Close Quarters
nodes.description: Increases your attack power by 6% and your Agility by 6%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases your attack power and Agility by 3%.' PORTS EXACTLY, doubled for the two ranks. BOTH KEYS ARE PERCENTAGE POINTS - and I first authored attack_power_pct as 0.06, assuming it was a fraction like attack_power's cousins, which audit_talents caught as '0.02%, not 2.0%'. That is the second time in one night the audit corrected a convention I guessed from the key name (the other was stun_duration_reduction_pct on Chronomancer's Timemage, which IS a fraction). There is no rule to infer it from: the audit is the only reliable check. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Jagged Cuts
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Toxic Dart and Ravage by 13.5% and their duration by 2 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage and duration of Toxic Dart and Ravage by 25%.' PORTS EXACTLY, both halves and both abilities - duration as a flat 2 turns since the key is an integer. BOTH ARE REAL DAMAGE INCREASES: abilities.py:2777 derives per-turn damage from the ability's OWN base duration, so a talent extension adds TICKS at full value rather than thinning a fixed total. Both dots go 3 -> 5 turns. SMALL INTEGERS IN TURNS, so spread() refuses to rank this node - correct, since a third of a turn per rank reads as nothing. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Dice Games
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Wild Strike and Assault by 10%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the critical strike chance of Wild Strike and Assault by 5%.' PORTS EXACTLY, both abilities, doubled. Wild Strike generates 14 Focus - the second-biggest generator - so this feeds Archery Master's crit-to-Focus loop too. Per-ability crit keys are PERCENTAGE POINTS. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Knuckleduster
nodes.description: Your attacks restore 6 Focus.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Periodic damage dealt now generates 5 Focus.' CoA fires this off dot TICKS, which are not a trigger - status_effects.py:914 ticks on the recipient with no caster handle - so it is re-pointed to on_weapon_swing, the melee equivalent. archery_points IS CoA's Focus. grant_resource routes through the same gain_resource() the five generators use, so the cap holds. FLAT `amount`; there is no pct_max.

nodes.name: Beatdown
nodes.description: Your attacks have a 20% chance to find a fault in the target's defenses, increasing your armor penetration for 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA level 20 passive: 'Auto attacks now have a 5% chance to reveal a fault in the enemy's defenses, causing your next instance of Physical ability damage to ignore Armor. Chance increased by 15% while wielding a polearm.' CoA gates this on a weapon type (polearm or daggers). NOTHING READS WEAPON TYPE anywhere in this engine, and there is no off-hand damage key either, so the condition is dropped and the node priced for the unconditional version. Eleven of Brigand's 39 CoA talents carry such a gate. 'Your NEXT instance ignores armor' cannot be built - nothing consumes a one-shot armour bypass the way bypass_execute_threshold does for execute gates - so the node carries a flat armor_penetration passive plus a short attack power window on proc, which is where 'ignore armour once' lands numerically. armor_penetration is a FLAT rating; attack_power inside a status effect is FLAT too (Monster.ability_power_bonus's caster-side twin). Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Excessive But Necessary
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Elude, Knockout and Cutthroat by 35%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the cooldown of Elude and Knockout by 4 sec.' Both are 6-turn cooldowns, so 4 sec is about 35% there. Extended to Cutthroat from CoA's Stalker ('Reduces the cooldown of Cutthroat by -15 sec, but reduces the range by -10 yds'), whose drawback is a range mechanic and therefore free here - flagged rather than quietly pocketed. *_cooldown_pct keys are FRACTIONS where POSITIVE MEANS A REDUCTION; talented_cooldown floors at 1 turn.

nodes.name: Bounty Hunter
nodes.description: Your attacks have a 30% chance to mark the target, increasing the damage they take from you by 15% for 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Damage dealt by Flank and Rusty Shiv now increases the target's damage taken from your Advantage spenders by 25% for 8 sec.' The debuff ports; the two-ability trigger does not (no per-ability proc trigger) and 'from your Advantage spenders' cannot be narrowed, so it applies to all your damage at 15% instead of 25%. 8 sec -> 3 turns. Folded in CoA's 'Tactical' Advantage, which does the same thing off Knockout and Bushwhack. CAREFUL: bare damage_taken_pct is read RAW ON BOTH SIDES, so 0.15 is 15% and authoring 15 would be +1500%. Asserted in main().

nodes.name: Highwayman
nodes.description: Your critical strikes increase your haste by 15% for 2 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Direct critical strikes while behind your target increase your haste by 15% for 5 seconds, or for your next 2 attacks.' PORTS ALMOST EXACTLY - the haste, the value and the window all survive. Only 'while behind your target' goes: there is no positioning in this engine at all. 5 sec -> 2 turns, which also happens to match CoA's own 'next 2 attacks' alternative. haste is PERCENTAGE POINTS.

nodes.name: Ambuscade
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Skullpiercer and Flank by 35% and your physical damage by 4%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the base damage of Skullpiercer and Flank by 20%, plus an additional 35% if you have a polearm equipped.' CoA gates this on a weapon type (polearm or daggers). NOTHING READS WEAPON TYPE anywhere in this engine, and there is no off-hand damage key either, so the condition is dropped and the node priced for the unconditional version. Eleven of Brigand's 39 CoA talents carry such a gate. The two values are merged at 35% rather than stacking to 55%, since the condition is gone. The small global comes from CoA's Trueshot Lodge Training ('+25% off-hand weapon damage; while wielding a polearm your Physical damage is increased by 3%'), which fails on both halves - no off-hand key and no weapon type - so only its unconditional intent lands. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Focused Fighter
nodes.description: Reduces the cost of Flank, Wild Strike and Assault by 10.8%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the Focus cost of Flank, Blackjack, and Wild Strike by -10%.' Blackjack is not in our Ranger book, so Assault takes its place - it is the spec's execute and the most expensive thing in the rotation. Doubled to 20%. CoA's Focus is our archery_points, so these are real cost reductions on a real pool. FRACTIONS where POSITIVE MEANS A REDUCTION. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Quick-Witted
nodes.description: Avoiding an attack stabs the attacker and slows their attacks for 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Avoiding an attack now causes you to quickly stab an enemy with one of the arrows from your quiver, dealing Physical damage and reducing their attack speed by -20% for 8 seconds.' PORTS ALMOST VERBATIM, and it is the reason this tree is worth building: on_avoid is a live trigger covering dodge, parry and block, and it only became meaningful when Kyle had creature avoidance added on 5 Nov 2026. THE ATTACK-SPEED HALF BECOMES FLAT ATTACK POWER: there is no caster-side speed debuff key, and attack_power is one of only eight status stat_mods a monster reads (and it is FLAT - 'Flat damage/healing swing from active buffs and debuffs'). damage_flat RATHER THAN leech_pct IS LOAD-BEARING: an avoided attack deals ZERO damage, so an amount-reading payload would deal and heal nothing while looking correct. Asserted in main(). 8 sec -> 3 turns.

nodes.name: Pilfering
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Dirty Blades by 10%, and your attacks have a 30% chance to heal you for 20% of the damage dealt.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Adds 10% to the damage dealt by Dirty Blades and causes its damage dealt to heal you equal to 50% of the value.' PORTS ALMOST EXACTLY. leech_pct is one of only three proc payloads that READ the triggering hit's amount, so '% of the damage dealt' is literally what it computes - and this is the right trigger for it, unlike Quick-Witted above where the amount is always zero. The Dirty-Blades scoping on the leech goes (no per-ability proc trigger) and 50% drops to 20% at a 30% chance in exchange, since it now fires off every swing rather than during one short window.

nodes.name: Tip of the Spear
nodes.description: Your attacks have a 15% chance to strike an additional time.
nodes._source: CoA: 'While you have a polearm equipped, your Wild Strike now has a 15% chance to strike 3 additional times.' CoA gates this on a weapon type (polearm or daggers). NOTHING READS WEAPON TYPE anywhere in this engine, and there is no off-hand damage key either, so the condition is dropped and the node priced for the unconditional version. Eleven of Brigand's 39 CoA talents carry such a gate. `extra_attack` IS A BOOLEAN GIVING EXACTLY ONE EXTRA ATTACK - it cannot be set to three, and there is no count field - so CoA's 3 becomes 1 at the same 15% chance. Flagged rather than faked: the description promises one strike, which is what happens. The Wild-Strike scoping also goes (no per-ability proc trigger).

nodes.name: Marked for Death
nodes.description: Increases your damage against enemies below 20% health by 25%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'While you have daggers equipped, direct critical strikes on enemies below 35% health now have a chance to allow the use of abilities as if you were in Elude for 5 seconds.' CoA gates this on a weapon type (polearm or daggers). NOTHING READS WEAPON TYPE anywhere in this engine, and there is no off-hand damage key either, so the condition is dropped and the node priced for the unconditional version. Eleven of Brigand's 39 CoA talents carry such a gate. 'As if you were in Elude' has no mechanism either - nothing grants a pseudo-state that other abilities test. What survives is the execute framing, built with low_health_damage_pct (the key added 6 Nov 2026 for the 48 CoA talents across 18 classes worded this way). THIS NODE DOES NOT SET low_health_threshold_pct: Archery's One Shot, One Kill owns it for the whole class at CoA's 20%, that key SUMS across talents, and a character can spend in several Ranger trees - a second setter would push the window to 40%. Asserted in main() and enforced class-wide by tools/qa_summing_thresholds.py. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Barbed Quills
nodes.description: Your attacks have a 35% chance to open a bleed dealing damage over 3 turns, stacking up to 4 times.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Damage dealt by Wild Strike and Quills will now tear into enemies, causing them to bleed for 69 to 75 Physical damage over 9 sec, stacking 4 times. Damage dealt by Quills now spreads your periodic effects to 5 enemies within 10 yds and extends their duration by 2 sec.' The bleed and its 4 stacks port; the spread clause does not (nothing copies an effect to other targets, and no payload extends a LIVE effect's duration). 9 sec -> 3 turns. A proc-applied dot carries `potency` as PER-TURN damage - 24 a turn, 72 per stack, 288 at four - where an ABILITY's effect_value is the total and gets divided.

nodes.name: Assassin
nodes.description: Increases the duration of Knockout, Crippling Shot and Throatpunch by 1 turn, and the healing of Survival Potion by 13.3%.
nodes._source: CoA has TWO talents named Assassin in this tree: 'Increases the duration of Knockout and Crippling Shot by 1 sec' and 'Increases the effectiveness of Instinct by 25%'. Merged, since a duplicate node NAME is rejected by main(). The durations port as flat turns; Throatpunch added as the third control ability of the same shape. Instinct is a restore_resource ability with no healing or damage key to scale, so its 25% is re-pointed to Survival Potion, the spec's actual heal. SMALL INTEGERS IN TURNS, so spread() refuses to rank this node.

nodes.name: Wild Man
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Wild Strike by 30% and of Quills by 25%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Wild Strike now strikes 2 additional nearby enemies, but deals reduced damage with each enemy struck.' NOTHING ADDS TARGETS TO AN ABILITY - no effect key and no proc payload touches an ability's target count, which also killed Quills' own per-stack target scaling and Reaper Soul's Ghastly Hilt - so both the upside and the stated drawback are dropped together and the node becomes flat damage. Extended to Quills, whose CoA talent fails the same way. Wild Strike generates 14 Focus. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Lacerations
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your periodic effects by 18%.
nodes._source: CoA level 40 passive: 'Allows the periodic damage dealt by Ravage to critically strike.' NOT BUILDABLE: dot and hot ticks NEVER roll crit in this engine, and there is no key to let them - status_effects.py applies a tick as a bare take_damage call with no crit roll anywhere in the path. CoA leans on this repeatedly (Archery's Bleeding Edge, Chronomancer's shared Impeccable Timing) and it fails every time. Repriced as dot_damage, which is what letting a bleed crit amounts to numerically and reaches every periodic effect this spec applies. A FRACTION. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Underhanded
nodes.description: Increases your attack power by 15% of your Agility.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases the attack power scaling of Skullpiercer by 15%.' A per-ability attack-power SCALING coefficient is not something any key reaches - the ability keys are _damage, _healing, _crit, _crit_damage, _cost, _cooldown, _duration and _potency, and none of them touch how an ability scales off a stat. Rebuilt as a real conversion instead: attack_power is in STAT_CONVERSION_TARGETS and agility in SOURCES, so a Brigand turning Agility into attack power is legal and reaches every ability rather than one. A FRACTION. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Dastardly
nodes.description: Increases your critical damage by 20%, your damage against enemies below 20% health by a further 25%, and your periodic damage by 15%.
nodes._source: CoA level 50 passive: 'Increases your critical damage dealt by 15% on enemies above 80% health or below 20% health.' The below-20% half builds with low_health_damage_pct; THE ABOVE-80% HALF CANNOT - high_health_damage_threshold_pct is dead data, authored and read by nothing, which also killed Archery's Opportunist. There is no conditional CRIT key either, only conditional damage, so CoA's 'critical damage' half becomes an unconditional crit_damage_physical plus conditional ordinary damage. The dot_damage ties the capstone to the bleed theme Jagged Cuts and Barbed Quills build. This node does NOT set low_health_threshold_pct - Archery owns it at 20%, so this stacks to 50% execute damage with Marked for Death on the same window. Was a pure scalar on our side.
